decisions.reason: The plan edits the specs that describe the permission, approval and command gate model, and the security review capability is installed, so the project rule to ask the owner applies. I added a checkpoint before the steps of the increment that edits them, which asks the owner and runs a review only on request.

The plan defers text that depends on the former global setup, but one increment fixes a single false plugin sentence that the global change made false. I made that an explicit exception for one false statement in a file the plan already edits, and left passages that rest on it to the second plan.
